title_seed: Direct paper search 是入口，不是 admission
central_problem: 使用者可以直接找到一篇 paper，是否代表它已足以支撐研究報告？
reader_takeaway: search UX、summary handoff 與 study-level evidence eligibility 要分開。

known_at_the_time.fact: 912babd 加入 user-facing direct paper search and summary workflow。
後續同日 commits 增加先展示更多 papers、progressive summaries 與 irrelevant-result filtering。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: paper-search page 與 API route 成為一條獨立的查找／摘要入口。

not_yet_available.fact: 直接搜尋入口不等於 later direct-study admission、full-text qualification 或 FORMAL evidence。

observed_failures.symptom: paper search can return a useful-looking record without proving it answers the study question
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: search/discovery and admission are different contracts
observed_failures.later_resolution: later direct-study and full-text QA measured those layers separately

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: One direct paper-search workflow is present in the 7/16 committed path; success coverage is not asserted.

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 direct paper search 做成可見入口，同時不把 UI result 自動升格為 formal evidence。

architecture_state.state: paper search route/page → normalized paper result → progressive summary handoff

safe_public_facts.fact: 讓人找到一篇 paper，與讓系統安全地使用它，是兩個不同的產品問題。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 direct-study coverage 與 qualifying full-text coverage 被分開報告；這是後來的 evidence accounting。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: direct paper search and summary workflow

publication_risks: 不要把 paper result count 寫成 evidence count。
不要公開 raw paper payload。
